summary: Tested in-app notification system for external agency content creation alerts. All 18 backend tests pass (100%). Fixed dropdown positioning issue in NotificationBell component. Frontend UI fully functional.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - Dropdown was positioned off-screen (x=-80) due to 'right-0' CSS when bell is in left sidebar
ui_bugs.fix: Changed to 'left-0 bottom-full mb-2' to position dropdown above bell icon

backend_apis.GET /api/notifications: WORKING - Returns list of user notifications with proper structure (excludes MongoDB _id)
backend_apis.GET /api/notifications/unread-count: WORKING - Returns count of unread notifications
backend_apis.POST /api/notifications/{id}/read: WORKING - Marks notification as read, returns 404 for invalid ID
backend_apis.POST /api/notifications/mark-all-read: WORKING - Marks all user notifications as read
backend_apis.POST /api/notifications/internal/create: WORKING - Creates notification for specified user_id
backend_apis.DELETE /api/notifications/{id}: WORKING - Deletes notification, returns 404 for invalid ID

frontend_ui.NotificationBell_component: WORKING - Bell icon visible in sidebar with data-testid='notification-bell'
frontend_ui.Unread_badge: WORKING - Shows count of unread notifications (red badge with number)
frontend_ui.Dropdown_positioning: FIXED - Dropdown now opens above bell icon (was off-screen before fix)
frontend_ui.Notification_list: WORKING - Shows title, message, time, link icon, unread indicator
frontend_ui.Mark_all_read_button: WORKING - Marks all notifications as read
frontend_ui.Click_outside_closes: WORKING - Dropdown closes when clicking outside

integration.social_sharing_notifications: VERIFIED - notify_org_admins function in social_sharing.py calls notification creation when external agencies create content (lines 495-503 for ideas, 559-567 for drafts)

seed_data_creation: Multiple test notifications created during testing via /api/notifications/internal/create
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification system is fully implemented. Backend router at /api/notifications with CRUD operations. Frontend NotificationBell component in sidebar. Fixed dropdown positioning - was using 'right-0' which didn't work in left sidebar, changed to 'left-0 bottom-full mb-2'. Notifications are triggered when external agencies create content via social_sharing.py (notify_org_admins calls).

bugs_fixed.issue: Dropdown positioned off-screen (x=-80) when bell is in left sidebar due to 'right-0' positioning
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed div class from 'absolute right-0 mt-2' to 'absolute left-0 bottom-full mb-2' to position dropdown above and to the right of bell
